title: Form-field outlines need 3:1 contrast against the background
rule: A text, number or select field whose fill matches the surface behind it is identified only by its border, so that border must reach 3:1 against the background in every theme (light, OS dark, forced dark). Use the `--fm-control-border` token, not `--fm-border` (≈1.5:1, for dividers only), and add a Playwright check that computes the ratio from the computed border and body colors under both color schemes.
rationale: E5.9 (#72): the new Settings inputs used `--fm-border` (#d4d4d4 on #fff, #3a3a3c on #1c1c1e ≈ 1.5:1), so empty fields were not discoverable (WCAG 1.4.11).
